Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tax ID parity check & PO onboarding — Bluecove Analytics

Hi Daniel —

Thanks for completing the supplier intake form. We’re ready to move Bluecove to the PO queue but hit a quick validation step: the EIN on the W-9 you uploaded (image file) appears truncated in our system (last four digits masked) and our bank-letter crosscheck shows a different formatting. Before Procurement can clear the PO hold we need one of the following:

1) A clear, signed PDF of the W-9 showing the full EIN, or
2) A bank letter (on bank letterhead) that references the legal entity name and full TIN/EIN, or
3) A notarized corporate resolution naming the authorized signer (if the W-9 signer is not the EIN holder) plus an unsigned copy of the W-9.

Can you confirm which you can provide today? If helpful, Monica (copied) can accept the documents via secure upload link.

Next steps after verification: Finance will issue the PO and we’ll share the PO number and remit instructions.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Martinez
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
